# Vocabulary: math_basis

Formal mathematical model a mechanic instantiates, explicitly or implicitly. Used to connect mechanics to research literature.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `system-dynamics` | System dynamics / ODEs | Stocks and flows, difference or differential equations. |
| `queueing` | Queueing theory | Arrivals, service rates, waiting lines, utilization. |
| `graph-search` | Graph search | Shortest paths, A*, flow fields, reachability. |
| `network-flow` | Network flow | Capacitated flows, max-flow, congestion, equilibrium assignment. |
| `cellular-automata` | Cellular automata | Local lattice update rules. |
| `markov-stochastic` | Markov / stochastic processes | State transitions with probabilities, random events, Poisson processes. |
| `game-theory` | Game theory | Strategic interaction, equilibria, bargaining. |
| `mechanism-design` | Mechanism design / auctions | Rules that shape incentives; auctions, voting, markets. |
| `optimization` | Optimization | Linear, integer, or combinatorial optimization; ratios and packing. |
| `control-theory` | Control theory | Feedback controllers, setpoints, stability, PID. |
| `classical-mechanics` | Classical mechanics | Rigid-body dynamics, constraints, collisions, orbits. |
| `continuum-mechanics` | Continuum mechanics | Fluids, heat transfer, deformation, stress. |
| `population-dynamics` | Population dynamics | Lotka-Volterra, logistic growth, age structure. |
| `epidemiology` | Epidemiology | SIR-family compartment models and contact networks. |
| `utility-decision` | Utility / decision theory | Agents choose by scoring options against needs or preferences. |
| `scheduling` | Scheduling | Job-shop, priority queues, timetabling. |
| `genetics-evolution` | Genetics / evolutionary computation | Inheritance, mutation, selection, fitness landscapes. |
| `social-network` | Social network models | Opinion dynamics, diffusion, homophily, influence graphs. |
| `procedural-noise` | Procedural noise / generative grammars | Perlin/simplex noise, L-systems, grammars, constraint solving for generation. |
| `probability-statistics` | Probability / statistics | Distributions, sampling, aggregation, ranking. |
| `information-theory` | Information theory | Uncertainty, signaling, hidden information. |
| `combinatorics` | Combinatorics | Recipe spaces, combination explosion, enumeration. |
| `computation-theory` | Computation theory | Automata, Turing-complete logic, program semantics. |
| `machine-learning` | Machine learning | Learned function approximation, reinforcement learning, generative models. |
